title: Do you have an answer ready? (Interview Tips) 🔎
description:
Do you have an answer ready for addressing the career gap on your resume? Chances are if you have made your career gap clearly visible on your resume and you still got the interview that's a good sign. Some recruiters won't hire you at all if you have a career gap...super cool right...but most just want to see how you've kept up your skills over your break. #interviewtips #interview #jobinterview #jobinterviewtips
